description.ncbi_summary: Enables MHC class II protein binding activity and protein phosphatase binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell surface receptor signaling pathway. Located in external side of plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Acts as a MHC class II receptor (PubMed:20519654). When stimulated on its own, does not play a role in cytokine production or the release of cytotoxic granules by NK cells and cytotoxic CD8(+) T cells (PubMed:17213291, PubMed:18991291). Does not act as an Fc receptor (PubMed:18991291).
